name: Cypher Vault
tagline: A password manager whose vault is encrypted on your device.
description: Cypher Vault stores your passwords in a vault that is encrypted on your device with your master password. If you sign in, only the encrypted vault is backed up, so the stored copy can't be read without your master password.
Cypher Vault is still in development. Keep another copy of anything important.

collected.data: Your vault, encrypted on your device
collected.why: Backup and sync. We cannot read it.

sent.data: First 5 characters of a password's one-way fingerprint
sent.why: Breached-password check. The password never leaves your device.

dataSafety.deletion: Email us to delete your account and vault backup.
extras: Your vault is encrypted with your master password before it leaves your device.
No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
